description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs (Profile trait) — The Profile::policy() method returns ValidationPolicy but the trait method has no #[must_use] attribute, while the free-function aliases (web_pki_policy, smime_policy, etc.) in pkix-profiles do have #[must_use]. A caller who forgets to use the returned policy silently does no validation. Fix: add #[must_use] to the Profile::policy fn in the trait definition in pkix-path. This is primarily a pkix-path fix but detected during pkix-profiles review.
title: [rusty/pkix-profiles] Profile::policy() trait method lacks #[must_use]
